key_provisions_or_claims: Coordination Group must set at least three request periods per year for joint scientific consultations on medical devices, by 30 November.
Developers submit requests and briefing packages via the HTA IT platform and may request parallel expert panel consultation.
Procedures for selecting individual experts, with conflict-of-interest checks and confidentiality agreements.
Synchronised exchange of information between the HTA secretariat and the EMA for parallel consultations.
Commission is data controller; retention of personal data up to 15 years, reviewed every 2 years.
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Regulation setting procedural rules for joint scientific consultations on medical and diagnostic devices under the HTA Regulation 2021/2282, including request periods, expert selection, coordination with EMA expert panels, and personal data processing. Not related to AI or robotics.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/117 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2021/2282 with regard to the procedures for joint scientific consultations on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
